title: elsholtzia angustifolia
intro: Elsholtzia angustifolia, commonly known as Chinese silvergrass or narrowleaf elsholtzia, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of E. angustifolia include bronchodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of E. angustifolia include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
